lines: Everything you can see is public and you may take as long as you like over it.
Everything behind me is staff, and I am afraid I am the whole of the reason why.
Signed in by Miss Veyl herself, which I have countersigned, which makes it mine.
Second floor is offices. Please do not open anything that is shut.
Four thousand a week has become eleven thousand a week and not one of them wants a tour.
I have still turned nobody away. I am not going to start with the ones who are angry.
There is a list on the counter of every floor in this building and what is on it. Take one.
Badges back at the desk when you go, and if you find a room you did not mean to,
come and tell me and nobody will be cross. Everybody does it once.
Four thousand people through those doors in a week and I have turned nobody away yet.
Ask me anything. If I do not know it I will find you the person who does.
Two coins a month since the flood. I have not stopped and nobody is going to talk me out of it.
They sent me the accounts on Friday, same as every year. It is a much longer document this year.
I have read all of it. Down to the pencils. That was the arrangement and they have kept it.
Two coins a month since the flood. It is not much and they never once said so.
They send me the accounts anyway. Every year. All of it, down to the pencils.
Free tour on the hour, and the assembly hall does a talk at four.
You have come a long way for a city with a hundred and sixty thousand in it.
Do not try to see it all today. Nobody has ever managed that.
Forty-one thousand back in the reed beds and the commission has been through every one of the books.
They found nothing. I have never been so pleased to have wasted a fortnight of somebody's life.
I still walk down and watch every release. That was never the part anybody had to come and check.
Bred here, tagged here, and let go in the reed beds at three months.
I have put forty-one thousand of them back and I still walk down and watch every release.
I have the specification for the deep tanks. It came down on Thursday in an envelope with my name on it.
Nine pins in open water, in a ring, at a hundred and forty fathoms. I have read it four times.
I asked twice and was thanked for my interest. I would like somebody to know that I asked.
You have a badge on. Then you can ask the question the public cannot.
No, I do not know what the deep tanks are for. I asked for the specification twice.
The second time I was thanked for my interest.
Shelf work, mostly. Currents, temperature, what lives where and why it stopped.
The deep survey is a different directorate. I have never been on one.
I have asked. It is not the sort of no that comes with a reason.
Nine thousand packs east in the spring and four thousand west this week, and not one cart was stopped.
Whatever they are pulling apart upstairs, nobody has been within forty feet of my warehouse.
That is the only sentence I have said all week that I am completely sure of.
Nine thousand packs east in the spring and every one of them paid for out of that box.
You want to know what the Foundation is? It is a warehouse and a fast cart.
The clever end of the building can argue about the weather. I just get there first.
There is still a bell on that shore. I came in and looked at the map before I read anything else.
A man I have never met did a wicked thing, and a bell I have never rung is still bolted to a rock.
I am eighty-one. I have earned the right to be simple about which of those I come here for.
My husband drowned in the year forty-nine, off a shore with no bell on it.
There is a bell on it now. I come in once a month to look at the map and see it.
That is all. That is the whole of my business here.
Thirty-one of them and I have counted twice, which means I have lost one.
They come every year. Half of them will work here one day and they all know it.
Miss says the sea between the two halves of the model is a walkway.
But it is still the sea. So really I am drowning. Look at me. I am drowning.
Every licence we hold is suspended and I am glad, because every one of them was ours to write.
Eleven sites and no weapons in any of them, and we were the most dangerous thing that ever walked in.
When they let me back out there it will be under somebody else's paper. Good.
Eleven Aurelian sites and not one weapon in any of them. Think about that.
They built rings, and floors that sing, and doors that open for the right voice.
Whatever these people were afraid of, it was not each other.
Twenty years, and on Monday I carried a DEEP SURVEY crate UP the west stair.
Two clerks from the capital signed for it in front of me and one of them said thank you.
A whale's jaw, a piano, and that. I am going to be telling people about that one.
Twenty years on this floor. I have carried out a whale's jaw and a piano.
Only thing I am not allowed to carry is anything with a DEEP SURVEY chalk mark.
Those go down the west stair with their own men. Never seen one come back up.
